title: Moroccan Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful Moroccan stew made with fish, moroccan spices, and a blend of aromatic ingredients.

ingredients.name: Fish fillets (such as cod or tilapia)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped dates and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the fish pieces and cook until they start to flake apart, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spice blend, fish tagine spice mix, salt, and pepper.
Stir well to combine, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
